subagentStatusLine.command: d=$PWD; p=; while :; do if [ -f "$d/.hippo/lanes/.statusline" ]; then p=$d/.hippo/lanes/.statusline; break; fi; if [ -z "$d" ] || [ -d "$d/.git" ] || [ "$d" = "$HOME" ]; then break; fi; d=${d%/*}; done; if [ -n "$p" ] && [ -O "$p" ]; then s=$(cat "$p"); case $s in /*/scripts/lane_status.py) [ -f "$s" ] && [ -O "$s" ] && exec python3 "$s";; esac; fi; exec cat >/dev/null
